title: Quick Crisp Russian Rice Pilaf
description: A buttery and crisp Russian dish featuring wholegrain bread and vegan-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the grated carrot and sliced mushroom, cooking until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cubed wholegrain bread to the skillet, stirring to combine with the vegetables.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked bread mixture, brown rice, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Spoon the rice mixture onto the center of the agave leaves.
Fold the agave leaves over the rice mixture to form a tight package.
Place the packages in the oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the rice is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the packages from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
